featured.title: Nigeria Begins Enforcement Of Sachet Alcohol Ban
featured.content: Nigeria's National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC) has begun enforcing its long-announced ban on the production and sale of sachet alcoholic beverages. Supporters say the policy could help reduce alcohol abuse, particularly among young people, while critics argue it may affect manufacturers, retailers and consumers who rely on lower-cost packaging.
